library.description: Images, videos and audio for your screens. Your plan includes {{limit}} GB of storage.
library.emptyBody: Upload images (JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF), videos (MP4, MOV, WebM, MKV) or audio. Drag files onto this page or use Upload media.
library.unsupported: This file type is not supported.
library.deleteBody: The file is removed permanently. Files used in a layout or playlist cannot be deleted.
library.name: Name
library.tagsHint: Separate with commas, e.g. menu, diwali
library.pickEmpty: No ready files of this type yet.

studio.description: Design multi-zone layouts for landscape and portrait screens.
studio.deleteBody: {{name}} will be deleted. Layouts used in a playlist cannot be deleted.
studio.emptyBody: Start from a template, then place media, text, clocks and QR codes in its zones.
studio.name: Layout name
studio.resolutionHint: Match your LED controller’s output. Portrait templates swap width and height.
studio.previewHint: Preview at {{w}}×{{h}} · Press Esc to close
studio.leaveTitle: You have unsaved changes. Leave anyway?
studio.laterWidgets: Weather, RSS and sensor widgets arrive in later phases.
studio.canvasHint: {{w}}×{{h}} · Drag to move, use handles to resize · Arrow keys nudge (Shift = 5%) · Delete removes
studio.selectHint: Select a zone on the canvas or in Layers to edit it.
studio.fitHint: Cover fills the zone and may crop; Contain shows everything with bars.
studio.playlistHint: Only playlists without layouts can play inside a zone.
studio.noZonePlaylists: Create a playlist of images or videos first.
studio.textHint: Hindi, Marathi and other scripts are supported.
studio.qrHint: A web address, phone number or any text.
studio.urlHint: https:// only. Some websites refuse to be shown inside other pages.
studio.tableHint: First line is the header. Separate cells with |

playlists.description: Sequences of media, layouts and widgets that play in a loop.
playlists.emptyBody: A playlist plays its items in order and loops. Schedules decide when each playlist plays.
playlists.name: Playlist name
playlists.deleteBody: {{name}} will be deleted. Playlists used by a layout or schedule cannot be deleted.
playlists.noItems: Add media, layouts or widgets to build the playlist.
playlists.previewHint: Loops through the items with their durations.
playlists.noLayouts: Create a layout in Layout Studio first.
playlists.widgetHint: Widgets fill the whole screen when played from a playlist.

schedules.description: Decide which playlist plays where and when. Higher priority wins when schedules overlap.
schedules.needPlaylist: Create a playlist first; schedules play playlists.
schedules.emptyBody: Schedules start playing on screens once screens are paired and content is published (coming in phases 3–4).
schedules.name: Name
schedules.noTargets: None created yet — add them under Sites & Groups.
schedules.overnightHint: An end time before the start runs past midnight.
schedules.priorityHint: 0–100. Use 50+ for promotions that should override regular content.
schedules.conflictsTitle: Overlapping schedules with the same priority
schedules.conflict: “{{a}}” and “{{b}}” overlap (first at {{at}}). Give one a higher priority so screens know which to play.
schedules.nothing: Nothing scheduled — screens show their default content.
schedules.testHint: Uses the same rules the screens use, including time zones and priorities.

groups.title: Screen groups
groups.description: Group screens (for example “Lobby walls” or “All Pune stores”) to schedule them together.
groups.name: Group name
groups.deleteBody: {{name}} will be deleted. Groups with screens or schedules cannot be deleted.
